i.norm: Shape with k=17 hash functions and m=72 bits, shared across all test helpers

Verifies that processBitMaps iterates over exactly as many long words as the shape requires, for both a populated filter and an empty one. A SimpleBloomFilter always allocates BitMaps.numberOfBitMaps(shape) longs regardless of content, so the iterator count must equal that value.
Populated filter: processBitMaps must visit every allocated long word
Empty filter: same expectation — allocation is shape-driven, not content-driven
